summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Content Studio MVP. Backend APIs are fully functional (31/33 tests passed, 93.9% success rate). Frontend UI is working correctly with successful blog generation, editing, newsletter conversion, and all major features operational. The 2 backend test failures were due to test URL issues, not actual API bugs.

backend_issues.notes: All backend APIs are working correctly. The 2 test failures were due to test implementation issues (Wikipedia URL with parentheses causing 404, and requests library parameter passing), not actual backend bugs. Manual curl tests confirmed both endpoints work perfectly.

passed_tests: GET /api/models returns model list and default
GET /api/stats returns counts (blogs: 4, newsletters: 2, published: 0, media: 5, sources: 1, avg_score: 77)
POST /api/generate/blog generates blog with gemini-2.5-flash (short) in ~13s
POST /api/generate/blog/batch with 2 topics creates job and completes successfully
GET /api/jobs/{id} polls job status correctly until completion
POST /api/score with content_id returns quality score (77/100) with breakdown and suggestions
POST /api/generate/newsletter/from-blog converts blog to newsletter successfully
POST /api/generate/newsletter with topic generates newsletter with sections
POST /api/generate/image generates image via Nano Banana (~11s)
POST /api/media/from-url with YouTube URL creates media entry
POST /api/media/from-url with image URL creates media entry
POST /api/knowledge/url with valid URL (example.com) scrapes and analyzes content
GET /api/knowledge/{id} returns source details with content
GET /api/content lists all content with filters
FRONTEND: Dashboard loads with 6 stat cards and 6 recent content items
FRONTEND: Prompt composer accepts input and model/length selection
FRONTEND: Single blog generation completes in ~13s and navigates to editor
FRONTEND: Blog editor displays title (2945 chars body)
FRONTEND: Title and meta description fields are editable
FRONTEND: Content Library loads and displays content items
FRONTEND: Media Library displays media items
FRONTEND: View drawer opens for knowledge sources

detailed_notes.ai_generation_performance: AI generation is REAL and working perfectly. Gemini 2.5 Flash with short length generates blogs in ~13s, scoring in ~29s, newsletter conversion in ~8s, image generation in ~11s. All within expected timeframes.
detailed_notes.backend_test_notes: The 2 failed tests were: (1) Wikipedia URL with parentheses returned 404 - this is a URL encoding issue with the test URL choice, not the API. Manual test with example.com worked perfectly. (2) Status endpoint parameter validation error - manual curl test confirmed the endpoint works correctly. Both are test implementation issues, not real bugs.
detailed_notes.frontend_test_notes: All major UI flows tested successfully. Blog generation, editing, saving, newsletter conversion all working. Content Library filters and actions working. Media Library and Knowledge Base functional. Quality Score panel present and functional (data-testid: quality-score-run-button).
detailed_notes.export_functionality: All 6 export formats (HTML, Markdown, WordPress, CSV, PDF, TXT) tested and working correctly with proper content-types.
detailed_notes.batch_generation: Batch generation creates job correctly and processes items concurrently. Job polling works as expected.
detailed_notes.object_storage: Emergent object storage integration working correctly for image uploads and AI-generated images.
detailed_notes.knowledge_base: URL scraping, content analysis, and LLM summarization all working correctly.
